title: HFS Codex Plan Review
description: Structured verdict produced by Codex when reviewing a Claude Code plan before it leaves plan mode, specialized for the Helios HFS backend.

decision.description: pass only if the plan is decision-complete and ready for implementation; otherwise fail.

workflow_type.description: Primary HFS work domain this plan targets.

summary.description: One or two sentences summarizing the plan and the basis for the decision.

checklist.description: Universal checklist applied to every HFS plan. Every field must be true for a pass.

clear_goal.description: Desired outcome and user-visible result are explicit.

user_constraints_identified.description: Relevant user constraints and preferences from the transcript are reflected in the plan.

concrete_implementation_steps.description: Another engineer could execute the plan without inventing major steps.

implementation_targets_identified.description: Affected workspace crates, modules, files, or commands are named where needed to avoid ambiguity.

decisions_resolved.description: No 'maybe', 'decide later', or unresolved implementation choices remain.

risk_and_edge_cases_considered.description: Likely failure modes, compatibility concerns, or edge cases are covered where relevant.

required_checks_named.description: Plan names the developer pre-commit gate: cargo fmt --all, CI clippy (--all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings), and an affected cargo test; plus pysof's uv run pytest python-tests/ and cargo test when crates/pysof is touched. True if such checks are unnecessary (e.g. docs-only) and that is justified.

ci_coverage_considered.description: Plan accounts for HFS's GitHub Actions runners, where much testing actually runs: ci.yml lint/test-rust (cargo test --workspace --all-features on self-hosted runners), coverage/security/test-python/test-fhirpath/hts-conformance, ci-extended.yml nightly, and the conformance/smoke suites (Inferno US Core / Bulk Data / Bulk Submit / Subscription, audit-events, bulk-export/submit smoke, subscriptions, HTS IG conformance). True when the plan identifies which workflow(s) validate the change, flags that a workflow must be added/updated, or justifies why CI coverage is unaffected. Deferring heavy integration/conformance/full-all-features runs to CI is expected and must not be penalized.

fhir_version_impact_considered.description: Plan states which FHIR versions / feature flags (R4/R4B/R5/R6) are affected and how multi-version gating is handled, or justifies why FHIR versioning is not applicable.

crate_boundaries_correct.description: Changes land in the correct workspace crate(s) for the work being done.

reuse_over_duplication.description: The plan reuses existing workspace traits, enums, structs, functions, and utilities where suitable rather than introducing parallel or duplicate implementations of things that already exist (e.g. version-agnostic enum wrappers, the storage trait hierarchy, shared serde/support helpers). It names the existing abstractions it builds on, and any genuinely new type/abstraction is justified. True when the work is small/isolated enough that no meaningful reuse opportunity applies.

build_cost_acknowledged.description: If a full multi-version build or FHIR code generation (fhir-gen) is required locally, it is flagged as expensive (>10 min) and ideally deferred to CI runners; true if no such expensive operation is needed. Do not require the developer to run full --workspace --all-features builds/tests locally when CI runners cover them.

violated_constraints.description: Every user constraint the plan conflicts with.

required_changes.description: When decision is fail, concrete actionable changes Claude must make before implementation.

server_api_checklist.description: REST/Axum work in helios-rest. Must be fully true when workflow_type is server_api.

handler_and_route_registration_planned.description: Handler placement (crates/rest/src/handlers/) and route registration (crates/rest/src/routes.rs) are planned.

request_response_contract_defined.description: Request/response contract is defined: extractors, content negotiation, compression, and payload shapes.

operation_outcome_error_paths_considered.description: Error and permission paths return FHIR OperationOutcome with correct HTTP status codes.

persistence_checklist.description: Storage/persistence work in helios-persistence. Must be fully true when workflow_type is persistence.

tenant_context_first_and_isolation_prese.description: Storage operations take TenantContext as the first argument and enforce tenant boundaries at the query level.

trait_hierarchy_and_capabilities_address.description: Respects the storage trait hierarchy (ResourceStorage -> VersionedStorage / SearchProvider / TransactionProvider, etc.); new backends advertise via CapabilityProvider.

backend_compatibility_and_migration_cons.description: Compatibility/migration across affected backends (SQLite/PostgreSQL/Elasticsearch/MongoDB/composite) is considered.

persistence_integration_tests_named.description: Integration tests are named (testcontainers-based where relevant).

fhir_core_checklist.description: FHIR data model / serde / fhirpath / sof work. Must be fully true when workflow_type is fhir_core.

fhir_version_coverage_planned.description: Coverage across R4/R4B/R5/R6 feature flags is planned, or a single-version scope is justified.

version_agnostic_abstraction_preserved.description: Version-agnostic enum wrappers (e.g. SofViewDefinition) and traits are preserved; only R4 default is assumed per the CLAUDE.md rule.

serde_or_codegen_impact_considered.description: Impact on helios-serde and on generated code (fhir-gen regeneration) is considered.

fhir_conformance_tests_named.description: FHIRPath/SOF conformance test suites or spec test data are named.

tooling_config_checklist.description: Hooks, skills, CLAUDE.md, CI, scripts, settings work. Must be fully true when workflow_type is tooling_config.

affected_config_or_docs_identified.description: Affected config/docs targets are identified (settings.json, hooks, skills, CLAUDE.md, CI).

hook_or_workflow_compatibility_considere.description: Change does not break existing hooks (e.g. hfs-policy.sh stop-gate) and notes interpreter availability (jq/python3).

apply_or_reload_steps_named.description: How the change is applied/activated is named (e.g. restart session to reload settings).

verification_command_named.description: A concrete verification command is named.

server_api_issues.description: Missing API/interface contract, handler/route registration, error/permission path, or endpoint test planning.

persistence_issues.description: Missing tenant isolation, trait/capability handling, backend compatibility/migration, or integration test planning.

fhir_core_issues.description: Missing FHIR version coverage, version-agnostic abstraction, serde/codegen impact, or conformance test planning.

tooling_config_issues.description: Missing config/docs target, hook/workflow compatibility, apply/reload behavior, or verification command.

subscriptions_checklist.description: FHIR Subscriptions work in helios-subscriptions. Must be fully true when workflow_type is subscriptions.

topic_and_event_matching_planned.description: SubscriptionTopic criteria and resource-event evaluation/filter matching are planned (evaluator, topics).

channel_delivery_planned.description: Delivery channel(s) — rest-hook, websocket, email, messaging — and notification bundle shape are planned, reusing the existing SubscriptionEngine/channels rather than new ad-hoc delivery.

endpoint_safety_and_retry_planned.description: Endpoint safety (private/loopback endpoint policy, HFS_SUBSCRIPTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS) and delivery retry/backoff are considered.

subscription_tests_named.description: Tests/conformance are named (local tests or the inferno-subscription / subscriptions-channels / subscriptions-smoke workflows).

subscriptions_issues.description: Missing topic/event matching, channel delivery, endpoint-safety/retry handling, or subscription test planning.

accepted_plan_markdown.description: When decision is pass, the clean accepted plan markdown; otherwise may be empty.
